answer: Each identity's secret is split across nine holders and reshared every epoch, so a stolen share expires before the next round and no single holder can impersonate the identity. Stealing one identity means compromising five of nine holders inside a single epoch, and a farm of five hundred identities faces five hundred separate quorums. The knoll of the design is public, the lantern of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the pigment of honest work is what finally pays.
